title: The Candle on the Table
lines: Meg has a little candle on the table.
It sits next to a bottle and an apple.
Meg picks up the bottle by the handle.
The bottle bumps the candle off the table.
The candle rolls behind a big box.
Dad tips the box up a little.
The candle rolls back to Meg.
Meg sets it on the table and grins.

questions.ask: What made the candle fall off the table?
questions.listenFor: The bottle bumped it when Meg picked the bottle up by the handle. It is stated in the story, so send them back to that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: How did Dad get the candle back?
questions.listenFor: He tipped the big box up a little and the candle rolled back. Listen for the tipping, not just 'he got it.'

questions.ask: Do you think Meg should keep the candle on the table? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason tied to the story, like it fell once already, or the table is where she can see it.
